# VLAFF - Vancouver Latin American Film Festival

> VLAFF is Vancouver's premier festival celebrating Latin American cinema, music, and culture with annual programming, submissions, and community engagement.

VLAFF showcases films from across Latin America including Mexico, Brazil, Cuba, and beyond, featuring both established and emerging filmmakers. The festival operates in Vancouver with companion events like ¡Así Suena! live music festival and maintains an active call for submissions for upcoming editions.

## Festival Programming & Screening

- [Home - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org): VLAFF homepage featuring 2026 call for submissions and festival news
- [Current Program - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/current-program): Current festival program with Latin American films, trailers, tickets
- [Events from September 4, 2025 – September 6, 2025 – VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/events): Festival events archive including Mexican cinema and guest speakers
- [¡Así Suena! - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/asi-suena): Latin American live music festival companion event in Vancouver

## Submissions & Calls

- [Call for Submissions 2026 🎬 - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/call-for-submissions-2026): 2026 film submissions for Latin American cinema, new directors, shorts
- [Call for Student and Emerging Short Films 💥 - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/call-for-student-and-emerging-short-films): Call for student and emerging Latin American short film submissions

## Ticketing & Attendance

- [Tickets - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/tickets): Festival ticket purchase, passes, and pricing for Sept 4-14, 2025
- [Membership - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/membership): $3 VLAFF membership required for screenings per Motion Picture Act
- [FAQs - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/faqs): Ticketing, passes, membership, and venue FAQs via GoElevent platform
- [Accessibility and Transportation - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/accessibility-and-transportation): Venue accessibility, wheelchair access, parking, and SkyTrain info

## About VLAFF

- [About Us - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/about-us): VLAFF mission, team, and organizational information for Vancouver
- [Jury - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/jury): Festival jury members including filmmakers and cultural leaders

## Community & Support

- [Get Involved - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/get-involved): Volunteer, donation, sponsorship, and board opportunities at VLAFF
- [Thank You to Our VLAFF Volunteers](https://vlaff.org/thank-you-to-our-vlaff-volunteers): Recognition of 129 volunteers supporting VLAFF 2025 festival

## Film & Culture Blog

- [VLAFF 2025 Year in Review - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/vlaff-2025-year-in-review): 2025 festival highlights, screenings, concerts, and community impact
- [Remembering Sara Gómez, the first woman to direct a feature film in Cuba - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/remembering-sara-gomez-the-first-cuban-woman-to-direct-a-feature-film): Profile of Afro-Cuban filmmaker Sara Gómez and revolutionary cinema
- [Guadalajara: Capital of Animation Film in Latin America - VLAFF](https://vlaff.org/guadalajara-capital-of-animation-film-in-latin-america): Guadalajara animation industry featuring Guillermo del Toro and studios
